questions.questionText:
Statements: Some caps are flowers. No flowers are gardens.
Conclusions:
I. It is possible that no flowers are caps.
II. Some flowers can be gardens.
Which of the following is correct?
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusion II follows
Only conclusion I follows
questions.explanation:
I. No flowers are caps: not possible; the opposite Some flowers are caps holds in every diagram.
II. Some flowers are gardens: not possible; the opposite No flowers are gardens holds in every diagram.
So neither conclusion holds.
Convention used: a possibility conclusion follows if at least one Venn diagram that fits the statements makes it true; 'Some' means at least one, and a definite conclusion follows only if true in every such diagram.
questions.shortcut: Possibility holds unless the statements force the opposite; test by drawing one diagram that keeps both statements true.
